scope: Generic read-only useRemote hook hardening and a new isolated frontend regression suite only

API.request_method: Existing request helper default GET, no request body
API.reload_scope: Only this hook attempt nonce; no external changed callback, conversation message/action/workflow request, model call or automatic retry loop

privacy_and_freshness_invariants: Returned data, error, loading and checkedAt are bound to exact path/token/revision/attempt/context before effects run
Every new request has data null, empty error, empty checkedAt and loading true
Cleanup marks its request inactive and aborts its own AbortController
Both promise callbacks and the deferred React updater refuse commits after cleanup or abort; no unguarded finally updater remains
Late resolution, non-AbortError rejection and late JSON body completion cannot replace newer scope data or freshness
A reload callback retained from an earlier render still schedules the current scope and current authentication
Context is an internal presentation boundary, not a grant of permissions or authority; server authentication and actor/tenant checks remain authoritative

tests.package_version_during_test: 0.3.2-rc.1 before root updated candidate metadata; source project was the clean0.3.3 checkout
coverage: One failed GET retries successfully without mutations or unrelated requests
First render after changed path/token/revision/context masks old successful data and fetch time
First render after changed scope masks old errors
Late old resolve/reject with ignored abort for each of four scope dimensions
Independent task and conversation hook reload counts
Stable older reload callback uses latest path and token
